What did you observe about Harbor's qualification process and June deliveries?

Qualifying a replacement component required a laboratory test and then a customer production trial.

In our June 2026 order ledger, every Harbor order arrived within the agreed delivery window.

I reviewed one supplier ledger. I did not review the distributor's records.
